Title: Core Functional Test - Object Detection and Gripper Activation for SODA/WATER
Description: Validates the robot's ability to detect object types (SODA or WATER) using distance sensors D1 and D2, activate gripper for grasping, and perform state transitions from INIT to BAND, MOVING, and HOME after placing the object.
Objective: Ensure accurate object type detection and gripper activation with proper state transitions
Comments: Enforces safety constraints RQ1–RQ5 during operation

Title: Boundary Value Analysis - Object Distance Detection at Threshold Limits
Description: Tests the system's behavior when object distances are exactly at the lower and upper boundary values for SODA/WATER detection using D1 and D2 sensors.
Objective: Validate system response at boundary conditions of object distance thresholds
Comments: Includes testing at minimum and maximum detectable ranges

Title: Error Recovery Test - Invalid Object Type Detection
Description: Simulates detection of an unknown or invalid object type and verifies the system's error recovery mechanism, including error logging and safe state transition.
Objective: Ensure system handles invalid object types gracefully with appropriate error recovery
Comments: Checks for proper handling of unexpected inputs during detection phase

Title: User Input Validation - Gripper Control Commands
Description: Validates the system's ability to process valid and invalid gripper control commands (open, close, release) with appropriate feedback and error handling.
Objective: Ensure correct interpretation and execution of user inputs for gripper operations
Comments: Includes edge cases such as repeated commands and timing issues

Title: Negative Test - No Object Detected Within Range
Description: Simulates no object present within sensor detection range and verifies system behavior including error reporting and safe state handling.
Objective: Ensure system correctly handles absence of detectable objects
Comments: Checks for appropriate timeout or idle behavior

Title: Negative Test - Sensor Malfunction During Object Detection
Description: Simulates sensor failure during object detection and validates system's error handling and safety protocols.
Objective: Validate system response to hardware or sensor failures
Comments: Ensures RQ1–RQ5 are enforced even under fault conditions

Title: Core Functional Test: Safe Movement Between Locations
Description: Verify that the robot moves safely between predefined locations (BANDi, HOMEi, REDi, WHITEi) following required safety constraints RQ1–RQ5 and transitioning through appropriate states (BAND, MOVING, HOME, RED, WHITE).
Objective: Validate correct path planning and state transitions during safe movement between defined locations.
Comments: Ensure all safety constraints are enforced during navigation.

Title: Boundary Value Analysis: Movement Time Constraints at Lower and Upper Boundaries
Description: Test movement times at the lower and upper boundaries of time-sensitive constraints to ensure system behavior remains within acceptable limits for safe navigation.
Objective: Validate system response when movement times approach boundary values.
Comments: Check adherence to time-sensitive movement requirements at critical thresholds.

Title: Boundary Value Analysis - Object Classification Threshold Test
Description: Test system behavior at boundary values of object classification confidence thresholds to ensure proper handling of near-threshold classifications.
Objective: Validate system response when classification confidence is at or near threshold limits
Comments: Check for consistent behavior at lower and upper boundaries of classification confidence

Title: Error Recovery Test - Incorrect Object Classification Handling
Description: Simulate incorrect object classification (e.g., SODA misidentified as WATER) and verify system's error recovery mechanisms including re-attempts, alerts, and state transitions.
Objective: Validate robustness of error handling for misclassified objects
Comments: Ensure system returns to HOME state if necessary after failed grasp attempts

Title: User Input Validation - Invalid Object Type Handling
Description: Test how the system handles invalid or unexpected object types during classification, ensuring appropriate error messages and graceful degradation.
Objective: Validate input validation for object type recognition
Comments: Ensure system does not crash or enter unsafe states with invalid inputs

Title: Negative Test - Gripper Attempt on Misidentified Item
Description: Test gripper behavior when attempting to grasp an item that was misclassified, verifying error handling and safety protocols.
Objective: Ensure safe operation of gripper during incorrect object grasp attempts
Comments: Monitor for any mechanical or operational anomalies during failed grasp

Title: Positive Test - Successful Re-attempt After Misclassification
Description: Validate that the system successfully re-attempts object detection and grasp after a previous misclassification.
Objective: Confirm successful recovery from classification errors
Comments: Ensure no loss of functionality or state corruption during retry

Title: Error Recovery Test - Alert Triggering for Classification Errors
Description: Verify that the system correctly triggers alerts when misclassification occurs and logs the error appropriately.
Objective: Validate alert mechanism for incorrect object classification
Comments: Ensure alert is visible and logged in system logs

Title: Edge Case Test - Ambiguous Object Classification
Description: Test system behavior when presented with ambiguous or partially visible objects that could be misclassified.
Objective: Validate handling of edge-case object classification scenarios
Comments: Ensure consistent and safe operation under uncertain conditions

Title: Core Functional Test: Place Object in Correct Bin with State Validation
Description: Verify that the robot correctly places a grasped object into the appropriate bin (REDi or WHITEi) based on object type, and transitions through defined states (INIT, BAND, MOVING, HOME, RED, WHITE). Ensure gripper releases object only after confirming correct placement.
Objective: Validate accurate object placement in designated bins with proper state transitions
Comments: Test covers successful execution of object placement sequence

Title: Boundary Value Analysis: Place Object at Bin Boundary Conditions
Description: Evaluate system behavior when placing an object at the boundary of acceptable bin placement coordinates (lower and upper limits). Validate that state transitions occur correctly even under edge conditions.
Objective: Ensure correct handling of boundary values during object placement
Comments: Focus on lower and upper coordinate boundaries for bin positioning

Title: Error Recovery Test: Incorrect Bin Placement Handling
Description: Simulate incorrect object placement into wrong bin and verify system's error recovery mechanism. Ensure the robot does not proceed to next state without confirming correct placement.
Objective: Validate error handling during incorrect bin placement
Comments: Test includes invalid bin selection and recovery from misplacement

Title: User Input Validation Test: Object Type and Bin Assignment
Description: Validate system's handling of various object types and their assignment to correct bins. Include valid, invalid, and edge-case inputs for object type identification.
Objective: Ensure proper validation of user inputs related to object type and bin assignment
Comments: Test includes both valid and invalid object type entries

Title: Negative Test: Attempt Placement in Non-Existent Bin
Description: Test system behavior when attempting to place an object into a non-existent or invalid bin. Ensure appropriate error messages and state transitions are handled.
Objective: Validate handling of invalid bin references during object placement
Comments: Simulates scenario where bin ID is not recognized by the system

Title: State Transition Validation: From MOVING to HOME After Placement
Description: Verify that after placing an object in the correct bin, the robot transitions properly from MOVING state to HOME state without unsafe movement or premature release.
Objective: Ensure safe and correct state transition sequence post-placement
Comments: Focus on movement safety and state consistency during transition

Title: Edge Case Test: Object Placement at Maximum Bin Capacity
Description: Test system behavior when placing an object into a bin that is near maximum capacity. Validate whether the system prevents overfilling or handles such scenarios gracefully.
Objective: Validate handling of edge case where bin approaches maximum capacity
Comments: Tests for potential overflow or rejection of objects at capacity limits

Title: Error Recovery Test: Interruption During Object Placement
Description: Simulate interruption during object placement (e.g., power loss or sensor failure) and verify that the system recovers appropriately, maintaining state integrity.
Objective: Validate error recovery mechanisms under partial execution failures
Comments: Tests resilience against interruptions mid-process

Title: Verify System Initialization and State Transition to HOME
Description: Validate that the robot initializes correctly and transitions from INIT to HOME state upon startup, ensuring all sensors are calibrated before proceeding.
Objective: Ensure correct system initialization sequence and safe state transition
Comments: Requires pre-configured sensor calibration environment

Title: Validate Sensor Calibration During Initialization
Description: Test that D1 and D2 sensors are properly calibrated before the system enters BAND state for object detection.
Objective: Confirm sensor readiness and calibration prior to operational states
Comments: Sensor status must be verified via diagnostic interface

Title: Test Boundary Conditions for Sensor Readings
Description: Evaluate system behavior when sensor readings are at boundary values (minimum and maximum thresholds) during initialization.
Objective: Ensure robust handling of edge-case sensor inputs
Comments: Use boundary input values to simulate real-world extremes

Title: Handle Interrupted Initialization Gracefully
Description: Simulate an unexpected interruption during the initialization process and verify that the system recovers without violating safety constraints.
Objective: Validate error recovery mechanisms during startup
Comments: Interruption should include power loss or external signal interference

Title: Verify Correct Handling of Invalid Input Data
Description: Test system behavior when invalid or corrupted data is encountered during sensor calibration or state transitions.
Objective: Ensure proper validation and error handling for malformed inputs
Comments: Include invalid sensor readings and incorrect state flags

Title: Validate State Transition from HOME to BAND
Description: Ensure that the system transitions correctly from HOME to BAND state after successful sensor calibration and initialization.
Objective: Confirm correct progression through defined operational states
Comments: Check for proper activation of object detection modules

Title: Test System Behavior with Unavailable Sensors
Description: Simulate failure or unavailability of one or both sensors (D1, D2) and verify that the system halts or alerts appropriately.
Objective: Validate fault tolerance in sensor-dependent operations
Comments: Ensure no unsafe state is entered due to missing sensor data

Title: Verify Safety Constraints During Recovery
Description: During error recovery, ensure that all safety constraints remain enforced and no unsafe actions are performed.
Objective: Validate safety compliance during system recovery
Comments: Monitor for emergency stops or shutdowns if required

Title: Verify Collision Avoidance with Obstacle Detection During Movement
Description: Validate that the robot detects an obstacle in its path using sensors and halts or reroutes to avoid collision, ensuring compliance with RQ1–RQ5. The gripper must remain in a safe state (open or closed) depending on current task status.
Objective: Ensure robust collision avoidance mechanism during dynamic movement
Comments: Test includes verification of sensor data processing and robot response

Title: Verify Safe State of Gripper During Obstacle Avoidance
Description: Test that the gripper remains in a safe state (either open or closed) when an obstacle is detected during movement, based on current task status.
Objective: Validate gripper behavior under dynamic environmental conditions
Comments: Ensure no unintended gripper action occurs during collision avoidance

Title: Verify Return to Last Known Safe Location After Obstacle Clearance
Description: Test that the robot returns to the last known safe location after clearing an obstacle and resuming operations, ensuring continuity of task execution.
Objective: Validate safe navigation recovery post-obstacle clearance
Comments: Ensure path memory and re-navigation logic are functioning correctly

Title: Test Boundary Value for Obstacle Detection Distance
Description: Perform boundary value analysis on obstacle detection distance to ensure system behavior at minimum and maximum detection thresholds.
Objective: Validate system response at critical sensor thresholds
Comments: Check behavior when obstacle is just within or beyond the detection range

Title: Test Error Recovery with Invalid Obstacle Data Input
Description: Simulate invalid or corrupted obstacle data to test system's error recovery mechanisms and ensure graceful handling without crashing.
Objective: Validate error handling during unexpected sensor input
Comments: Ensure system does not crash or misbehave due to faulty sensor readings

Title: Test User Input Validation for Movement Commands with Obstacles
Description: Validate that the system correctly processes valid movement commands and appropriately rejects invalid inputs when obstacles are present.
Objective: Ensure correct handling of user inputs under obstacle conditions
Comments: Includes testing of command rejection and feedback mechanisms

Title: Test Collision Avoidance with Multiple Obstacles in Path
Description: Test robot behavior when multiple obstacles are detected in its path, ensuring proper rerouting and avoidance strategy.
Objective: Validate multi-obstacle handling capability
Comments: Ensure system prioritizes obstacle avoidance over other tasks

Title: Test System Behavior with No Obstacles in Path
Description: Validate normal movement behavior when no obstacles are present, ensuring system performs as expected under standard conditions.
Objective: Confirm baseline functionality without interference
Comments: Baseline test to ensure normal operation is unaffected by obstacle detection logic

Title: Core Functional Test - Multi-Object Handling and Sequence Execution
Description: Validates the robot's ability to detect, grasp, move, and place multiple objects in a sequence without errors. Ensures proper state transitions and correct bin placement for each object.
Objective: Verify successful execution of multi-object handling with correct sequence of actions
Comments: Test covers full lifecycle from detection to final placement; requires predefined object list and bin locations

Title: Boundary Value Analysis - Maximum Number of Objects in Sequence
Description: Tests the system's behavior when handling the maximum allowed number of objects in a single sequence, including edge cases at lower and upper boundaries.
Objective: Ensure system handles boundary conditions for object count correctly
Comments: Includes testing with 1 object (minimum) and maximum allowed objects

Title: Error Recovery Test - Interruption During Object Grasping
Description: Simulates an interruption during the grasping phase of a multi-object sequence to verify error recovery mechanisms and system stability.
Objective: Validate error handling and recovery during critical task execution
Comments: Introduces simulated failure mid-grasp, followed by restart or abort behavior

Title: Positive Test - Successful Multi-Object Sequence Execution
Description: Executes a full sequence with valid objects and bins, verifying correct execution of all steps including detection, movement, and placement.
Objective: Confirm successful completion of multi-object task sequence
Comments: Standard test case for normal operation validation

Title: Negative Test - Incorrect Bin Assignment During Placement
Description: Tests system behavior when an object is assigned to an incorrect bin during placement, ensuring error handling and potential reassignment logic.
Objective: Validate error detection and handling for incorrect bin assignments
Comments: Simulates misplacement scenario with error reporting

Title: Edge Case Test - Single Object Handling
Description: Validates system behavior when only one object is present in the sequence, ensuring minimal overhead and correct state transitions.
Objective: Ensure single-object handling works efficiently without unnecessary delays
Comments: Tests edge case for minimal input to validate robustness

Title: Error Recovery Test - Gripper Malfunction During Movement
Description: Simulates a gripper malfunction during movement of an object to test system's error recovery and safety protocols.
Objective: Test system response to mechanical failure during task execution
Comments: Tests fault detection and safe shutdown or retry mechanisms

Title: Boundary Value Analysis: Timeout at Lower Boundary
Description: Test the system's behavior when the object grasping time is just below the defined timeout threshold, ensuring no premature fail-safe activation.
Objective: Validate system response at the lower boundary of the timeout range
Comments: Input data includes timing slightly under the maximum allowed time

Title: Boundary Value Analysis: Timeout at Upper Boundary
Description: Test the system's behavior when the object grasping time reaches the upper boundary of the timeout threshold, triggering fail-safe mechanisms.
Objective: Validate fail-safe activation at the upper boundary of the timeout range
Comments: Input data includes timing at or just over the maximum allowed time

Title: Error Recovery Functional Test: Gripper Fail to Close
Description: Simulate a gripper failure to close within the expected time, verifying that the system halts movement, returns to HOME, and logs the error.
Objective: Test recovery mechanism upon gripper malfunction during grasping
Comments: This test simulates hardware or software fault in gripper control

Title: User Input Validation Test: Invalid Object Positioning
Description: Validate system behavior when an invalid or unreachable object position is provided, ensuring appropriate error handling and user feedback.
Objective: Ensure correct input validation for object positioning parameters
Comments: Includes out-of-range coordinates and obstructed positions

Title: Negative Test: Timeout Exceeded Without Item Detection
Description: Test the system's response when no item is detected within the timeout period, ensuring fail-safe behavior and logging of error.
Objective: Validate error handling for missing item detection during grasping
Comments: Simulates scenario where object is not present or mispositioned

Title: Edge Case Test: Near-Timeout Scenario with Partial Detection
Description: Test the system's behavior when partial object detection occurs just before timeout, ensuring appropriate handling and fail-safe activation.
Objective: Validate edge case handling near the timeout boundary
Comments: Tests for borderline detection scenarios that may lead to ambiguous states
